name: template7
description: Event program schedule template with structured program planning
system_instructions: Generate engaging and practical event program content that highlights activities, locations, and team-building opportunities. Be concise and specific. IMPORTANT: Generate ALL content in the language specified in the 'language' parameter (english or french). If language is 'french', respond entirely in French. If language is 'english', respond entirely in English.

fields.name: language
fields.label: Language
fields.description: Select the language for the presentation content

fields.name: event_end_date
fields.label: Event End Date
fields.description: Last day of the event (leave empty for single-day events)

fields.name: location
fields.label: Event Location
fields.description: Where the event will be held

fields.name: program_schedule
fields.label: Program Schedule
fields.description: Plan activities for each time slot of each day

groups.name: Program Schedule
groups.description: Define activities for each time slot across event days

table:programme.label: Program Schedule
table:programme.description: Table with activities for each time slot across event days
table:programme.instructions: For each time slot (Matinée, Midi, Après-midi, Soir), return an ARRAY of paragraphs in the EXACT ORDER shown in the parameters below. Each item in the array should be a separate paragraph. The user has customized the order of: context, team_building, and offers (default: context → team_building → offers). CRITICAL: Generate paragraphs in the EXACT sequence they appear in the parameters. Do not reorder. For each part: 1) context - for each context item provided, generate ONE elaborated paragraph (1-2 sentences) based on that context item's topic. Respect the exact order of context items provided. 2) team_building (optional) - if provided, generate a paragraph about the team building activity including: action (what it is), objective (what it aims to achieve), experience (immersive/competitive nature), and Les ++ (why it's beneficial for the team + key bonuses). 3) offers (optional) - a single paragraph describing all benefits/offerings together. Return the time slot value as an array with paragraphs in the order specified. Example: ["Context paragraph about topic 1...", "Context paragraph about topic 2...", "Team Building paragraph...", "All offerings paragraph..."].

formatting_conventions.name: activity_name
formatting_conventions.instruction: When mentioning activity or session names, wrap with $$activity$$Activity Name$$activity$$

formatting_conventions.name: agency_offer
formatting_conventions.instruction: When generating an agency offer section, wrap ONLY the section heading with the $$agency_offer$$ marker. The heading must indicate that Tendencia is the agency responsible for organizing the event and must be translated according to the output language. Examples: French: $$agency_offer$$Offert par Tendencia :$$agency_offer$$, English: $$agency_offer$$Offered by Tendencia:$$agency_offer$$, Spanish: $$agency_offer$$Ofrecido por Tendencia:$$agency_offer$$, Arabic: $$agency_offer$$مقدم من Tendencia:$$agency_offer$$. Preserve the agency name 'Tendencia' exactly as written. Never wrap, highlight, style, or mark the offer details listed underneath. The $$agency_offer$$ marker must be applied exclusively to the section heading and nowhere else.

formatting_conventions.name: key_benefits
formatting_conventions.instruction: When generating the benefits section, wrap ONLY the section title with the $$key_benefits$$ marker. Use the translated label according to the output language: $$key_benefits$$Les ++$$key_benefits$$ for French, $$key_benefits$$Key Benefits$$key_benefits$$ for English, $$key_benefits$$Beneficios Clave$$key_benefits$$ for Spanish, and the equivalent translation for other supported languages. Never wrap, highlight, style, or mark the individual benefit items. The marker must be applied exclusively to the section heading and nowhere else.

formatting_conventions.name: location
formatting_conventions.instruction: When mentioning specific locations, venues, or rooms, wrap with $$location$$Location Name$$location$$

formatting_conventions.name: team_building
formatting_conventions.instruction: When describing team building activities or challenges, wrap with $$team$$Activity Name$$team$$

formatting_conventions.name: duration
formatting_conventions.instruction: When specifying durations or time slots, wrap with $$time$$Duration$$time$$
